scheme_name: Medical Expenses for Treatment of Major Ailments of a Beneficiary
other_conditions: Construction worker must be registered under the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board.
Spouse and children of the construction worker are eligible for assistance.
Applicant must be suffering from any of the listed major ailments (TB, Cancer, Heart Disease, Kidney Disease, Eye Disease, Leprosy, HIV Disease, or Nerve Disease).
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹2,000 per year for minor treatments and up to ₹45,000 per major surgery.
